items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Kid Randy in their turns; the name is only introduced by the interviewer to clarify a previous statement about a band.

ctx.x: He had a guitar. Lewis Gibbon was playing with him then. Oh yeah. Yeah. You know Lewis Gibbon. He died. I knew him then. Yeah, well they had some kind of misunderstanding. That's how I handed it to how I knew. Did you know Earl Barnes? I think I asked you. No, I don't know Earl Barnes. Paul Barnes. Clarence Tisdale, did you ever know him? I would. I don't know him. You might get talked about. Did Gypsy T-Room, what band was that band?
Randy. Kid Randy. Did we get that on the tape?
I think we did and then we might as well do it again. You had a saxophone player there with you. Delarue.
